role: Real kill-switch state machine — the genuine Containment_Unit gap Fort Knox named that nothing built tonight covered. Scope-aware: a tenant, feature, or region can be independently contained/released; the same target ID under a different scope is correctly treated as unrelated.
behaviorDescription: containTarget()/releaseTarget() manage a real, scope-aware containment registry. isContained() checks scope+targetId together, verified against real cases including the same-ID-different-scope case before implementation.
hardStops: Never conflates two different scopes sharing the same target ID
Never silently loses a containment record — release explicitly sets status to active rather than deleting history
